The source documents gender selection два/две and examples два стакана, две книги, три книги. Cornell directly attests the numeral phrases два стакана, две книги, and три книги. The rule is restricted to the nominative-form numerals; other declined numeral forms have other case patterns, and numerals five and above use genitive plural.
